question:
The bar graph represents the production of different spare parts of computer in different months.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86f8f35b4eb3e0ffb05f2891d629f6b2966db2399a9317169a3bc8b0fdceeb51.png] 

The ratio between the number of pen drives produced in the month of Jan, March and April is:
solution:
**Solution:**

Jan = 1500

March = 1500

April = 3000

According to the question, 

1500 : 1500 : 3000

⇒ 1 : 1: 2

**∴ The ratio between the number of pen drives produced in the month of Jan, March and April is 1 : 1: 2.**
